editorial.blurb: Chicago Magic Lounge transports you into an intimate speakeasy where world-class magicians perform close-up illusions that'll leave you wondering how it's even possible—all while sipping excellent cocktails.
editorial.insiderTip: Book the premium seats to gain access to the exclusive 654 lounge for an even closer, more intimate magic experience; arrive early for cocktail hour when different magicians work the room before the main event.
